subject: dawnbringer blade
fact: Dawnbringer deals radiant damage, not slashing.
source_quote: Dawnbringer is not slashing, right? It's actually… Radiant damage.

subject: underdark
fact: The Underdark is tight and low, and we're almost out.
source_quote: The Underdark is tight and low. But we're almost out.

subject: lack of ranged weapons
fact: None of us have ranged weapons, which means there will absolutely be something that needs hitting from a distance.
source_quote: we none of us have ranged weapons, which means there will absolutely be something that needs hitting from a distance.

subject: demon princes
fact: Daz reserves his genuine surprise for things like demon princes and sentient oozes.
source_quote: the kind he usually reserves for things like demon princes and sentient oozes.

subject: zhentarim tactics
fact: Zhentarim Tactics is a school of thought — brutal, efficient, not entirely reputable — that goes by the name Zhentarim Tactics.
source_quote: Zhentarim Tactics.

subject: menzoberranzan
fact: Menzoberranzan trained Daz to read the moment before committing to a decision with surgical attention.
source_quote: Menzoberranzan trained me to read that moment with surgical attention.

subject: warcaster feat
fact: Warcaster improves concentration checks, which is essential for maintaining spells like Hypnotic Pattern and Maximilian's Grasp.
source_quote: Warcaster, which gives them improved concentration checks.

subject: fey touched
fact: Fey Touched grants two additional spells to prepare and free castings.
source_quote: Fey Touched gives me two additional spells to prepare. Plus free castings.

subject: misty step
fact: Misty Step allows escaping grapples without attacks of opportunity when cast without expending a spell slot.
source_quote: being able to cast it without expending a spell slot is extremely useful. Because if you're in combat, it allows you to get out without incurring attacks of opportunity.

subject: telekinetic feat
fact: Telekinetic allows moving allies five feet to reposition them in combat.
source_quote: Telekinetic, I can aim this at allies and do things like get them out of a grapple. Move them five feet.

subject: sculpt spells
fact: Sculpt Spells lets the wizard carve exclusions into area effects like Cloud of Daggers.
source_quote: Because I have my ability to shape spells, I can call Cloud of Daggers on an enemy—

subject: long arrangement
fact: The 'long arrangement' is the idea that positioning and preparation are most of the fight.
source_quote: Milo Goodbarrel had a chapter about this. He called it 'the long arrangement' — the idea that the fight before the fight, the positioning, the preparation, is actually most of the fight.

subject: street justice feat
fact: Street Justice lets Zalthir use rope to bind enemies he's already grappled.
source_quote: the one that let him use rope to bind enemies he'd already grappled.

subject: darkness spell conflict
fact: Darkness and fire spells have historically conflicted between Daz and Zalthir due to line-of-sight issues.
source_quote: The Darkness spell has always been the problem between Daz and me.

subject: cloud of daggers + grapple synergy
fact: Grapple locks an enemy in place, making Cloud of Daggers permanently effective on them.
source_quote: If you hold one in place, the daggers keep finding them.

subject: grapple and rope action economy
fact: Grapple uses a bonus action; binding with rope consumes the entire action, creating a full-turn setup.
source_quote: Grapple is a quick thing — one motion... The binding would consume the action itself. The whole turn — both pieces of it — spent on one enemy...

subject: monastery
fact: Zalthir recalls a monastery class on battlefield geometry and control vs. proximity.
source_quote: There was a class on this. At the monastery. Something about battlefield geometry and the difference between control and proximity.

subject: drow wizard mentorship
fact: Zalthir is learning battlefield geometry from a Drow wizard in a tunnel.
source_quote: I am currently learning it from a Drow wizard in a tunnel.

subject: pudding king takedown
fact: Zalthir pulled the Pudding King out of its lair by sheer force of tactical geometry.
source_quote: I'd watched him pull the Pudding King out of its lair by sheer force of tactical geometry.

subject: dwarf raised by giants
fact: The narrator believes being raised by giants means he doesn't need range — giants toss rocks, and his role is to protect them.
source_quote: being a dwarf raised by giants means I don’t have to have any range. Giants toss rocks. Those rocks go far and hurt. My job was to be there and protect the giants from anything that came too close.

subject: potion hoarding habit
fact: The narrator admits to hoarding potions as a bad habit — the potion you don't drink is the potion you die holding.
source_quote: The potion you don't drink is the potion you die holding.

subject: giant strength potion strategy
fact: The narrator considers drinking a potion of giant strength when it matters, rather than investing in permanent strength increases.
source_quote: skip the investment, drink the potion of giant strength when it matters.

subject: hill giants
fact: The narrator carries lessons from hill giants in the shape of every fight he's won.
source_quote: The hill giants weren't always good people either, and I carry their lessons in the shape of every fight I've won.

subject: dark transition
fact: The narrator has undergone a dark transition — from a happy-go-lucky kid to someone who understands the Underdark doesn't care what kind of person you want to be.
source_quote: I've had what you might call a dark transition. The happy-go-lucky kid who went underground expecting something survivable has spent months watching demon lords and eating mushrooms and coming to understand that the Underdark doesn't care what kind of person you want to be.

subject: tactical geometry commitment
fact: Zalthir commits to obscure specializations and tries to break the universe with them.
source_quote: I find it more fun to double down with some sort of obscure specialization and then try to break the universe with it.

subject: systemic spell synergy
fact: Daz's spell selection, concentration durability, and escape utility form an interlocking system of battlefield control.
source_quote: These were not independent features. They were a system. The Evoker's toolkit is not a collection of separate spells; it is an interlocking argument about where enemies should be, where allies should be, and which parts of a room I am willing to set on fire.

subject: combat geometry as decisive factor
fact: The Underdark has taught repeatedly that battles are often decided by who is standing where.
source_quote: The Underdark had taught me repeatedly that battles are often decided by who is standing where.
